title: Japanese Equities Set to Fall on Tech Share Selloff, Higher Oil
description: Japanese stock futures are pointing to a lower open as a weekend spike in crude prices and renewed inflation concerns weigh on the artificial intelligence trade.

title: Taiwan Dollar Bulls Look Past AI-Led Selloff to Year-End Rally
description: The Taiwan dollar’s weakness led by global jitters over the artificial intelligence trade is masking the island’s underlying economic resilience that favors the currency’s rally into year-end, analysts say.

title: Woodside Pauses Scarborough Pre-Commissioning Due to Protest
description: Woodside Energy Group Ltd. said that pre-commissioning work at its $12 billion Scarborough liquefied natural gas export project off the coast of Western Australia was paused after Greenpeace protesters climbed aboard the gas platform.
